budget_items.what_was_recorded: Ms. Lehtinen estimated the curbside yard waste service would cost around $20.00 per household per year.
budget_items.quote: ms. lehtinen reported that from her research it would come to around $20.00 per year per household for this service.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The projected Summer Street cost was reported to exceed the originally projected cost and was estimated at higher figures with escalation.
budget_items.quote: the projected cost exceeds the $6.9 million cost originally projected.

budget_items.quote: by reviewing all the different design components, vhb has been able to reduce the price of the project down to $8.5 million.

budget_items.topic: Turkey Hill Middle School ceiling and facia work
budget_items.what_was_recorded: School facilities work at Turkey Hill Middle School was reported at about $30,000 for ceiling and facia work.
budget_items.quote: turkey hill middle school may have $30,000 in ceiling and facia work

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A heated maintenance garage at Turkey Hill Middle School was reported at a cost of around $30,000 and will go out for bid.
budget_items.quote: into a heated maintenance garage at the cost of around $30,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Mr. Bursch stated the water district authorized borrowing for the new maintenance garage.
budget_items.quote: mr. bursch stated they authorized borrowing $1.4 million for the garage.

budget_items.topic: Cost of Water District study committee article (Article 45)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Asked whether the study committee article had a cost, Ms. Lafleur said it did not, and it was understood to be a voluntary fact-finding committee with no funding.
budget_items.quote: ms. bertram asked if there was a cost associated with this article and if so, was it in the budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Verizon proposal funding stream of $30,000 per year with a 3% annual escalator, starting once a building permit is issued.
budget_items.quote: the funding stream would be $30,000 annually with a 3% annual escalator.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The first ten years of the cell tower lease would generate revenue of $343,000.
budget_items.quote: the first ten years would generate revenue of $343,000.

budget_items.topic: Artificial turf field replacement funding contributions (Article 28)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The school athletic budget, Lunenburg Youth Soccer Association and Lunenburg Bengals Association contributions, with cell tower revenue, total $77,500 annually.
budget_items.quote: the school through the athletic budget will contribute $25,000 to this replacement plan.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Maintenance of the turf field (cleaning and respreading pellets twice a year) costs $1500 per year from the athletic budget.
budget_items.quote: the maintenance is $1500 per year and comes from his budget.

budget_items.topic: T.C. Passios / Brooks House FY 2017 operating costs
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Projected FY 2017 operating costs for the T.C. Passios building: utilities, building maintenance, supplies and labor.
budget_items.quote: utilities costs are just under $50,000, building maintenance costs are $6,100, maintenance supplies cost $8,500 and labor is just under $70,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Total projected operational costs for the building were stated.
budget_items.quote: the total operational costs are projected at $134,328.

budget_items.topic: FLLAC rent for T.C. Passios back wing
budget_items.what_was_recorded: FLLAC agreed to an annual rental fee of $95,000 for the same space.
budget_items.quote: fllac has agreed to an annual rental fee of $95,000 for the same space.

budget_items.topic: Proposed rents for other T.C. Passios occupants
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Proposed annual rents: Lunenburg Public Schools $15,000, extended day program $20,000, and P.A.C.C. $10,000 (currently paying $6,000).
budget_items.quote: we are also looking to charge rents to three other entities; $15,000 per year to lunenburg public schools, $20,000 for extended day program

budget_items.topic: T.C. Passios reserve for unanticipated costs
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The rents would leave a reserve of just under $6,000 for unanticipated expenses; with a reinspection expense the total is just under $10,000.
budget_items.quote: that would leave us with a reserve of just under $6,000 in case of unanticipated expenses.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The current year budget is $265,000; Ms. Lafleur proposed increasing it to $275,000, fully funded through Pay as You Throw.
budget_items.quote: the current year budget is $265,000.
